gauge.name: Neuse River at Main St in Seven Springs

impacts.statement: Water reaches the base of the Main St bridge.
Moderate flooding begins.  The Seven Springs Boating Access will begin to flood.
Minor flooding begins.  The Seven Springs boat access is underwater.

dataAttribution.text: NC Flood Inundation Mapping and Alert Network

gauge.forecastReliability: Forecasts are not available. Only observed stages are available for this point.
